title: The Shepherd Boy Becomes King
reflectionQuestion: God promised David something wonderful, then stayed close through all the long waiting until the day it came true. When you have to wait a long time for something, what helps you keep on trusting?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (David Becomes King, 2 Samuel 5) -- the David cluster's culmination (promise kept), distinct from the anointing (kid_david_shepherd). Mood=joyful. Theme: God keeps his promise over long waiting; God-with-David from sheep to throne. Hard days (fleeing from Saul) named gently in one line. Indelible image: the shepherd boy who carried lambs, now crowned king. Adam: accepted as short+full, NO long. Voice TBC at audio (proposed VOICE_MIRIAM_JOYFUL).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.
